title: Maavinkai Appe Huli
description: Tantalizing Malnad raw mango rasam-broth seasoned with green chillies, aromatic asafoetida, and tempered cumin in pure coconut oil.

steps.instruction: Pressure-cook cut raw mango pieces with slit green chillies and water for 4 whistles until soft.
Allow to cool, mash pulp thoroughly by hand in the cooking water, and sieve to extract smooth tangy juice.
Heat coconut oil in a pan; add jeera, hing, and fresh curry leaves to crackle.
Pour tempering into the raw mango broth and bring to a gentle 1-minute boil.

storyOrOrigin: A timeless Malnad summer digestive preparation made with tart wild raw mangoes, served alongside piping hot rice and papad.
grandmasSecrets: If you want to take the rasam path, dry-roast jeera and black pepper and crush coarsely with a mortar and pestle.
